material.value: Does mlua (rust/crates/mod-host/Cargo.toml features) allow a second Lua instance used only for off-tick validation, given ModHost holds Rc (not Send)?
material.witness_evidence: rust/crates/mod-host/Cargo.toml: mlua 0.10 features lua54, vendored; no send feature, so Lua is not Send. Validation uses a fresh Lua on the caller thread, before any swap; no cross-thread state.
